text:
</sub>  Bind precision evidence to the cohort model

When the real-PR cohort uses a different model from the precision fixtures, this gate can still admit the recall claim: AC9's “same model” requirement only binds the sweep-on and sweep-off precision arms to each other, while this text explicitly binds only the category-list version and effective sweep configuration to the claimed heads. A clean precision result from model A can therefore support a recall claim measured with model B even though false-positive behavior is model-dependent; require the precision evidence's model identity to match the real-PR comparison's model.
